# Supplement Intelligence

Verification-first supplement formulation and ingredient research.

Preferred canonical pages:
- https://supplement-intelligence.com/
- https://supplement-intelligence.com/products
- https://supplement-intelligence.com/references
- https://supplement-intelligence.com/about

Current status:
- Product formulations and clinical citations are being re-verified.
- Historical citation totals and retired research datasets should not be treated as current evidence.
- "Under Review" means no finalized evidence grade or formulation verification is being asserted.
- Manufacturer pages support formulation facts, not efficacy claims.

- https://supplement-intelligence.com/ingredients
- 26 ingredient evidence records are currently published. Each separates ingredient evidence from finished-product directness.
